question: A 220 m long train, travelling at a speed of 99 km/h, completely crosses another train coming from the opposite direction at a speed of 81 km/h in 9 seconds. Find the length of the second train (in metres).
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (opposite direction) = 99 + 81 = 180 km/h

Relative speed in m/s = 180 × 5/18 = 50 m/s

Total distance (sum of lengths) = Speed × Time = 50 × 9 = 450 m

Length of second train = Total distance − First train length

Length of second train = 450 − 220 = 230 m

**∴ The correct answer is 230.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first train (L₁) = 220 m

Speed of first train (S₁) = 99 km/h

Speed of second train (S₂) = 81 km/h

Time taken to cross each other (T) = 9 seconds
